remarks: Outstanding unit at The Classic, a fantastic & luxurious building in the heart of downtown Stamford. Open floor plan, spacious & sunny large living room with balcony & downtown views. Kitchen with granite, stainless, and breakfast bar. Dining room. Wood flooring & both bedrooms have new carpeting. Luxurious master bath, walk in closet. *Included in rent: hot water, cooking gas, 1 garage space, 24 hour concierge, heated pool, fitness center, sundeck, outdoor park with grills, doggie area, and a beautiful community room with sweeping views of downtown. Steps away from restaurants, theater & shops. Impressive lobby with fireplace, concierge desk. A wonderful lifestyle awaits you. ~Ask agent about move-in requirements. Good credit and credit history a must.
